name: Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp Unit
summary: Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp. operates as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), established on November 3, 2025. Based in George Town, Cayman Islands, this entity is primarily dedicated to identifying and merging with technology-driven businesses. It places a particular emphasis on innovative sectors, including artificial intelligence leveraged by blockchain technology, digital trade identity solutions, and robotics.
